title: Citizen data (citizen-data/1)
description: Every decision a citizen made in a run, captured while it ran, for training a citizen model of our own (docs/citizen-data.md; docs/design/citizen-model.md section 1). A stream beside the run's log (`<run>.citizens.jsonl.zst`: JSON lines, zstd, in frames), never in it: a run is the same with it on. Rows (`row`): one `segment` first; then, step by step in the order the engine carries a round out, each person's `turn`s, `outcome` and `record`. A person's record at a turn is the fold of that person's `record` rows above it (each section set whole replaces the one before). Built only from what the person's own mind held and the kernel kept for them: nothing of the world's registers. `oikos citizen-data` turns a stream into training rows (Example).

Hex64.description: A value of the kernel's random stream (xoshiro256**, crates/core rng.rs), as 16 hex digits: a u64 does not fit a JSON reader's number. Its share of 2^64 is the uniform draw.

Segment.description: The stream's first row (and the first of each part a run taken up again from a snapshot wrote: rows after it from `from_t` replace what an earlier part wrote from then on).

citizen.description: The version of the citizen's rules (the `citizen.default` kind) that decided.

Draw.description: A stream of the kernel's the person opened since their decision before this one (in that step), in order: its key (who, what for, the matter or the day, the nth time), and the values the decision took from it (`drawn`, where the mind says which stream it chose with: every value, in order) or the stream's first value (`u`: a single draw, as `below(n)` takes it). The last stream before a decision is, as a rule, the one it was decided with.

Turn.description: One decision of a person's: as their mind recorded it (`decision`: the data of the log's `decision` annotation, the same whether or not the log keeps it: domain, strategy, options with their facts and scores, choice, and the situation, circumstances and state it was decided in), its number `n` (the person's count: what an outcome's `of` names), and its draws.

Outcome.description: What the person came to know, in one step, of how things went (the data of the log's `outcome` annotation): each names the decision it follows by `of`, where it is one of theirs.

Record.description: A change to the person's own record (contracts/entity-record.schema.json), as their step asked the kernel to keep it: the sections set, whole, and what happened since the last (`because`).

Example.description: A training row (`oikos citizen-data`, orchestrator/src/citizen-data.ts): one turn with the person's record folded as it stood (`record`: sections; `record_at`: when it was last changed, absent before the first), the draws, and every outcome that names the turn (`outcomes`). `exclude_from_training`: the turn is on a day of a run that a real test case of the translator came from (translator/eval/pilot-cases.ts), which stays out of all training.
